messages:
Aisha: vendor (Vertex Supply) just raised unit price on new PO by 6%. PO-4992. they say chip shortage premium.
Tim: ouch. do we have committed pricing for this tranche?
Procurement: committed pricing up to 100 units at previous rate for existing contract, but this PO is outside that MSP window. Vertex proposes 6% uplift or delayed shipping.
Aisha: delay hurts capacity. what's the delta in $/unit?
Procurement: previous $/unit: $55,000. new: $58,300. uplift ~$3,300/unit. For 12 units that's +$39.6k.
kate-sre: infra note: we can stagger usage by shifting non-critical workloads to spot pool for 7 days. but training-queue-prod will still need at least 6 units.
ops-bot: ALERT: cluster headroom 7 days remaining for prod-train w/ current queuing policy.
CarrierBot: shipping note: Vertex can prioritize 8 units for next flight at no extra freight if paid by EOD. remaining 4 pushed to next week.
Procurement: negotiation plan: accept 8 units at old price, push pricing discussion for remaining 4. vendor will hold pricing for 72h under verbal agreement.
Aisha: ok proceed on 8 units. create PO amendment and request RMA loaner clause for potential DOA.
Tim: finance check?
Procurement: Finance flagged increased ARR impact but OK to proceed for 8 units. need amendment signed today.
Aisha: action items: 1) Procurement amend PO and attach RMA clause (Procurement) 2) SRE reserve slot for 8 immediate intake (kate-sre) 3) Carrier confirm flight booking (CarrierBot). I'll update #eng-runtime after amendment.
CarrierBot: flight reserved for 8 units, tentative pickup Thu 06:00. AWB VTX-777.
Aisha: thanks team.
